card.statement:
The generator $c_{nk}$ of $\Gamma_q$ acts on $T(L)$ as a scalar multiplication by

$$\gamma_{nk}(L)=(k)_{q^{-2}}!(n-k)_{q^{-2}}!q^{k(k+1)+\frac{n(n-3)}{2}}\sum_{\tau}
q^{\sum_{i=1}^{k}l_{n\tau(i)}-\sum_{i=k+1}^{n}l_{n\tau(i)}}$$

where $\tau\in S_n$ is such that $\tau(1)<\cdots<\tau(k), \tau(k+1)<\cdots<\tau(n)$.
card.label: Proposition 7

paper.title: Irreducible subquotients of generic Gelfand-Tsetlin modules over $U_{q}(\mathfrak{gl}_n)$
paper.abstract: We provide a classification and explicit bases of tableaux of all irreducible subquotients of generic Gelfand-Tsetlin modules over Uq(gl(n)) where q different 1 and -1.
